twelve_labs_qa.summary: No Twelve Labs QA result (extension may not have run)

ux_observations.observation: Branding add-on is active but both chrome_show_name and chrome_streamer_name are empty strings. Output currently displays 'AuraFlux' in the top bar AND lower-third simultaneously, making this look like platform promotional spam rather than creator content.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Block staged outputs when branding=true and chrome_name fields are empty. Require at least one of show_name or streamer_name to be non-empty before assembly completes, or auto-disable branding overlay if unconfigured.

ux_observations.observation: TikTok Clutch template is described as 'single high-energy gaming moment' but source is tagged as 'irl_event' (basketball fight footage, not gaming). 333s duration also far exceeds typical TikTok clutch moment length (usually 15-60s).
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add content_type validation to template — TikTok Clutch should require content_type in ['gaming', 'esports']. Flag source duration >90s as needing manual trim selection or auto-highlight extraction.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA shows 'no result (extension did not run)' — this is the content safety/moderation check that should flag a physical altercation before staging. Pipeline pushed to staged status without any QA validation.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Make Twelve Labs QA a blocking dependency for OPERATE tier jobs. If extension fails to run, job should halt at 'pending_qa' status, not auto-advance to 'staged'.

ux_observations.observation: Source is third-party streamer content (AdinRoss) being processed for an unknown user. Output would post someone else's viral moment with no attribution, branding shows 'AuraFlux' instead of original creator, creating potential DMCA/attribution issues.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Implement source ownership validation — if clip.channel !== user.linked_channels, require explicit 'repost rights' confirmation or add mandatory attribution overlay.

ux_observations.observation: Portrait format applied to what is likely landscape IRL stream footage of a basketball court. Standard fight footage would have significant cropping issues with subjects moving laterally across frame.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Run aspect ratio analysis on source before format lock. If source is landscape 16:9 with high horizontal motion, recommend landscape output or require manual safe-zone confirmation for portrait crop.

ux_observations.observation: Six add-ons stacked including 'effects' on IRL event content. Gaming effects (kill feeds, damage numbers, etc.) would look incongruous on basketball fight footage.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Filter available effects add-on presets by content_type. IRL events should only surface IRL-appropriate effects (slow-mo, zoom, impact frames) not gaming HUD elements.

ux_observations.observation: Branding add-on is active but both chrome_show_name and chrome_streamer_name are empty strings. Output has 'AuraFlux' watermarked in top bar AND lower-third simultaneously — reads as platform spam rather than creator-branded content.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Block branding add-on from activating unless at least one of chrome_show_name or chrome_streamer_name is explicitly set. For this job: populate chrome_streamer_name with 'Greekgodx' from source metadata.

ux_observations.observation: Job status is 'failed' but output URL was still generated and passed to QA. Twelve Labs QA shows 'no result (extension did not run)' — failed jobs should not reach QA stage, or QA should flag the failure state before evaluating assets.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Add pipeline gate: if job.status === 'failed', halt QA and return early with failure reason. Do not evaluate partial outputs from failed jobs.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA extension did not run, meaning no automated content validation (profanity, copyright audio, dead frames) was performed before this output would ship.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Make Twelve Labs QA mandatory for all longform YouTube outputs. If extension fails to run, block release and alert Rob with extension error logs.

ux_observations.observation: 380s gaming_reaction content fits within template bounds (300–3600s) and longform format is appropriate for YouTube Deep Dive. No source fit issues.

A real streamer (Greekgodx) would not post this output: it displays competitor branding ('AuraFlux') instead of their identity, job failed so quality is unknown, and no QA verified the content is clean for YouTube monetization.
ux_observations.suggested_change: This output should be blocked from delivery. Require passing job status + valid branding + completed QA before marking any YouTube longform as ready.

ux_observations.observation: Add-on stack [captions, audio, branding, colorGrade, effects, layout] is reasonable for gaming_reaction content. No TTS on voiced content, no conflicting add-ons detected.
ux_observations.suggested_change: None required — add-on selection is appropriate for content type.
